summary: Tatsumi's 1985 off-road racing game, released as Speed Buggy in North America and known for its panoramic three-screen arcade cabinet.

entries.title: Buggy Boy

emulation.notes: Use the panoramic arcade version where supported for the intended wide display.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Three-screen arcade presentation with modern scaling

primary.why: Buggy Boy was developed for arcades with a panoramic three-screen cockpit cabinet, later receiving a single-screen Buggy Boy Junior cabinet and home-computer ports. The panoramic arcade version is the highest-fidelity and most authentic route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; choose the panoramic cabinet set where supported.

all_releases.fidelity: Original panoramic arcade cabinet with three-screen display.
